initial_application: Commit 8f2ecf67d20f0ee5e8b4a2cbc68adbf170901920 explicitly applied the issue by adding source/questionnaire/questionnaire-example-practitioner-info.xml and an entry for it in source/questionnaire/list-Questionnaire-examples.xml.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini, the current example list still references Questionnaire/example-practitioner-info, and the example contains item.definition URLs pointing to Practitioner ElementDefinitions. The current Questionnaire narrative explains item.definition, ElementDefinition-derived metadata, canonical fragments, logical-model references, and external-definition alignment. FHIR SDC minutes confirm the 2020 vote and note that examples already existed; Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The existing authoritative Questionnaire source already satisfies the issue request, and adding more prose or another example would be redundant for this Jira decision.
